sections.kicker: Prepared for House Balthazar by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: House Balthazar has a voice with an opinion. The profile keeps it to itself.
sections.keep: Your caption "We're not trying to be everyone's cup of tea. We prefer Champagne." It is the clearest reason to pick you over any wine room nearby.

pins.what: The bio lists two products and none of the attitude.
pins.why: Woodinville has other places to drink champagne. The reason to choose yours lives in your captions, not in the bio.
pins.how: Open the bio with the stance, then the products.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: A stranger reads the bio and sees a macaron counter with a wine list.

pins.area: Yellow heavy sans slide next to a white serif gratitude slide
pins.what: The grid speaks in three typographic voices.
pins.why: The navy and gold monogram promises a quiet champagne house. The big yellow block type says something louder.
pins.how: Pick the voice of the monogram and let it carry every slide.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The house reads like three small brands sharing one feed.

pins.what: Your sharpest line about the macarons never reaches the grid.
pins.why: It tells a buyer in four words why these macarons are not the ones in the pastry case.
pins.how: Give lines like this a repeatable slide next to the product shot.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The best joke you own is read by the few who open the caption.
